system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Perform these two different actions simultaneously: ifms_get_retailer_list and ifms_resolve_transaction_ambiguity.. my aadhaar_number is 100020007820, my location is dummy_location_3905.

function.name: ifms_resolve_transaction_ambiguity
function.description: Resolves ambiguous or conflicting transaction records when duplicate or partial transactions are detected. Returns disambiguation details. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify transactions. Fails if no ambiguity detected.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

function.name: ifms_get_retailer_list
function.description: Returns list of authorized fertilizer retailers/dealers in a location. Only purchases from authorized retailers qualify for subsidy. Requires session_token. Does NOT initiate purchases. Fails if no authorized retailers found in the area.
